name: SegmentedControl
description: `SegmentedControl` is a single-choice Base UI toggle group for related view or mode choices.

props.name: action
props.description: Supplies the action region. Takes precedence over a matching `SegmentedControl.Action` child.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the control to fill its container, sharing the width between segments.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the segments.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual treatment of the control. `subtle` drops the track for a lower-emphasis control. Pass an object to adapt per
viewport range, for example collapsing into a menu or hiding labels on narrow viewports.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label. It stays on one line and truncates with a tooltip when the segment is too narrow.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown after the segment's label.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Icon shown before the segment's label: a component such as an Octicon, or a rendered element.

props.name: value
props.description: Value this segment selects, matched against the control's value.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the segment, since the icon alone conveys nothing. Shown in the tooltip by default.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown after the segment's label.

props.name: description
props.description: Supplementary text shown in the tooltip instead of the label and exposed as the accessible description.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to render: a component such as an Octicon, or a rendered element.

props.name: tooltipDirection
props.description: Side and alignment of the tooltip relative to the segment.

props.name: value
props.description: Value this segment selects, matched against the control's value.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the divider.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the divider.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents the action from being activated.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component for the action.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the action, shown in its tooltip and as the menu item text in the dropdown variant.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and suppresses activation.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the action is activated.
